Perused the report dated 17.05.2023 of the DLSA regarding service of notice.
2. There is no appearance on behalf of the informant/victim when the matter is called.

3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
4.

The petitioner is an accused in connection with Special POCSO Case No.22 of 2023, pending before the Court of the learned A.D.J.-cum-Special Judge, under POCSO Act, Bhadrak, arising out of Chandbali P.S. Case No.53 of 2023 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n)/376(3) of IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

5. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned A.D.J.-cum-Special Judge, under POCSO Act, Bhadrak by order dated 21.04.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
6. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 10.03.2023 and as charge sheet has already been filed on 11.04.2023, he may be released on bail.
7. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

9. Considering the same, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
10. Additionally, it is directed that the petitioner shall not in any way try to intimidate the victim and/or her family.
11. It shall be open to the prosecution to seek variance of this order, in the event there is any threat perception.
12. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
